svg.text: Index Build Time vs Dataset Scale (PG18 BEIR Matrix)
x-axis: document count (log scale) | y-axis: build time (log scale)
Note: build time reflects index construction only; it excludes query execution and per-VM orchestration overhead.
Representative largest dataset: msmarco | upstream 3.2m | ids 57.12s | text[] 1.6m | pg_search 1.2m | vchord 1.7m
